embodied in

  • CURIE: gmeow:embodiedIn
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/embodiedIn
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/creative-works

Relates an Expression to a Manifestation that embodies it. Non-functional: an Expression may be embodied in many Manifestations (hardcover, paperback, EPUB). Inverse of gmeow:embodies.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Expression -> gmeow:Manifestation

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:embodiedIn from gmeow:Expression to gmeow:Manifestation when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Expression, gmeow:Manifestation
